tuv.seg: Absolutely! We understand that not everyone can support our mission financially, but there are many ways to help Mozilla and be a part of our community. In fact, the success of our mission depends on participation from people like you. Find the best way for you to get involved with our community here.

Kakare! Wa niang ni pe dano weng twero cwako micion wa iyoo me cente, ento tye yoo mapol mukene me konyo Mozilla ki bedo ikin lwak ma megwa. Iye ada, cobe pa micion wa jenge ikom mine pa dano calo in. Nong yoo maber loyo pi in me nywako ki lwak ma megwa kany.
Visit this link to make a secure online donation right now via credit card or PayPal. For additional ways to give — like checks or donations of stock — visit our Ways to Give page.
Lim kakube man me miyo kony iwiyamo kombedi iyoo me kredit kad onyo PayPal. Pi yoo mukene me miyo kony — macalo cheque onyo miyo jami — Lim potbuk wa me Yoo me Miyo kony.
Below are the most frequently asked questions about donating to the Mozilla Foundation.
Man obedo lapeny ma ki maro penyo ne i lok me miyo kony bot Mozilla Foundation.
Lapeny me pol kare pa Lami Kony
Generally speaking, only long enough to do what we collected it for. Please refer to the Mozilla Privacy Policy for more details.
Ikom lok, teke wa tyeko tic ma oweko wa gamo ngec meno. Tim ber inen Cik me Mung pa Mozilla pi ngec mapol.
How does Mozilla ensure my personal information is protected?
Mozilla neno nining ni ngec mamega kigwoko maber?

If you have a question about donating to the Mozilla Foundation, please contact us via this form. We will do our best to follow-up with you within 72 hours. If you need technical support for products such as Firefox, please contact Mozilla Support for assistance.

Kacce itye ki lapeny ikom miyo kony bot Mozilla Foundation, tim ber i kube kwedwa ki i pwom man. Wa bitute ki kero wa duc me kube kwedi ikare ma pe kato wang cawa 72. Kacce imito kony me diro pi jami calo Firefox, tim ber i kube ki Kony pa Mozilla pi nongo kony.
I’m unable to give money at this time, are there other ways I can help Mozilla?
Pe atwero miyo kony me cente kombedi, tye yoo mukene ma atwero konyo ki Mozilla?
What are the ways I can donate?
Yoo mene ma aromo miyo kede kony?
When I make a donation, how long do you retain my data?
Kacce amiyo kony, igwoko ngec mamega pi kare ma rom mene?

When you donate to the Mozilla Foundation, we receive personal information from you. We use this data to acknowledge your donation, provide you with donation receipts, and correspond with you through newsletters or email. You can read more about what information we receive, the purposes we use that information for, and how we handle it in our Privacy Policy.

Kacce imiyo kony bot Mozilla Foundation, wa nongo ngec mamegi ki boti. Wa tiyo ki ngec man me moko mic me kony mamegi, miyo boti recit me miyo kony, ki kube kwedi iyoo me gazetti ngec onyo email. Itwero kwano ngec mapol ikom ngec mene ma wa nongo, ngo ma watimo ki ngec meno, ki kit ma gwoko kwede i Cik Me Mung.

Buttons that let you like or share things to Facebook or let you log in to websites using your Facebook account contain trackers. Facebook Container will block these trackers and display the fence icon to show you where trackers were removed.

Facebook Container creates a boundary between Facebook sites and the rest of the web so it’s harder for Facebook to track you online.

Cel me Facebook Container ki kwot.
Facebook Container isolates your Facebook activity from the rest of your web activity in order to prevent Facebook from tracking you outside of the Facebook website via third party cookies.

Ripot me yot kom pa Firefox

Firefox Health Report (FHR) analyses your browser's performance information, in order to provide you with useful tips that help you get the best from Firefox. For more information on Firefox Health Report, visit the Mozilla Support section.

Ripot me yot kom pa Firefox (FHR) ngiyo ngec ikom tic me layeny mamegi me miyo yin ngec mogo mabeco me konyi nongo jami mabeco ki bot Firefox. Pi ngec mapol ikom Ripot me yot kom pa Firefox, lim but Mozilla me Kony.

Firefox Health Report (FHR) records anonymous data about your computer, configuration, usage, performance, and error conditions. This data helps us improve Firefox for you and for other Firefox users.
Ripot me Yotkom pa Firefox (FHR) gwoko data mape ngene ikom kompiuta ni, ter, tic kwede, tic, ki bal. Data man konyo wa me yubo Firefox maber piri ki pi lutic ki Firefox mukene.
Firefox Health Report lets you know how your Firefox is performing and what you can do to improve it.
Ripot me yot kom pa Firefox weko i ngeyo kit ma Firefox mamegi tye katic kwede ki ngo ma i twero timo me yilo rwom me malo.
Firefox Health Report lets you optimize your Firefox and helps us build a more excellent browser. Reports will be pretty basic at first, but will continue to evolve and grow.
Ripot me yot kom pa Firefox weko iyubo Firefox mamegi bedo ma opore ki konyo wa me yubo layeny maber loyo. Ripot bi bedo yot tutwal ii acaki, ento bi mede ki loke ki dongo.
Firefox Health Report records information about your browser and device. You can see the information we record. You can also see what you share with Mozilla.
Ripot me yot kom pa Firefox gwoko ngec ikom layeny ki nyonyo mamegi. I twero neno ngec ma wagwoko. Itwero bene neno ngo ma inywako ki Mozilla.

For each browsing session, Firefox Health Report records approximately how long you browsed (in seconds), and whether the session ended normally or because of a crash. Also includes startup times (in milliseconds) if available.
Pi kare me yeny acelacel, Ripot me Yotkom pa Firefox gwoko kare marom mene ma i tero i yeny (i ceken), ki kace kare ne otum maber onyo pien pi poto. Bene kwako kare me cako (i milliceken) ka tye.

Mozilla is not your average organization. Founded as a community open source project in 1998, Mozilla is a mission-driven organization working towards a more healthy internet. The majority of Mozilla Corporation’s revenue is from royalties earned through Firefox web browser search partnerships and distribution deals around the world. You can learn more about how we make money in our annual financial report.

Mozilla pe obedo dul mamegi ma tye ladyere dyere. Kicako calo purujek ma tye ayaba pa lwak i mwaka 1998, Mozilla obedo dul ma miti aye dwoyo matiyo pi intanet ma opore kato. Pol cente ma Mozilla Corporation coko bino ki i cul ma kinongo ki i cato wil me yeny pa layeny kakube me Firefox ki pok me cat ki wil i but wilobo. Itwero nongo ngec mapol ikom kit ma tiyo kwede cente i ripot wa me lok kom lim ma bino mwaka ki mwaka.

Thimble by Mozilla - An online code editor for learners & educators.
Thimble pa Mozilla - Layub kod iwiyamo pi lunong ngec ki lupwonye.
Yoo me boko lok pa Thimble

Thimble is a full-featured code editor that runs right in the browser. It's designed to help new coders create their own sites and web-based projects using HTML, CSS & JavaScript. Everything you need is at your fingertips, allowing you (or your classroom) to get up and running as quickly as possible.

Thimble obedo layub kod ma tye ma opong ma tiyo ii layeny kikome. Ki yubo me konyo luco kod manyen cweyo kakube gi ki purujek me kakube kun tiyo ki HTML, CSS & JavaScript. Jami weng ma imito tye iwii lweti, weko i (onyo i ot kwan mamegi) aa malo ka cako ngwec oyot cutcut.
Thimble is an online code editor that makes it easy to create and publish your own web pages while learning HTML, CSS & JavaScript.
Thimble obedo layub kod iwiyamo ma weko bedo yot me cweeno ki coono potbuk me kakube mamegi ma kun inongo pwonye HTML, CSS & JavaScript.

Thimble is part of the Mozilla Learning Network.
Learn to teach like mozilla at learning.mozilla.org.

Thimble obedo but Netwak me pwonye pa Mozilla.
Pwony kit me pwony calo mozilla ii learning.mozilla.org.
Thimble works in all of the following browsers: Firefox, Chrome, Internet Explorer 11, Microsoft Edge, Safari (8+), and Opera.
Thimble tiyo i layeny magi weng: Firefox, Chrome, Internet Explorer 11, Microsoft Edge, Safari (8+), ki Opera.
Thimble works like a real web project, you can create, rename, delete and even upload your own files.
Thimble tiyo calo purujek me kakube kikome, itwero cweeno, loko nying, kwanyo ki bene keto pwail mamegi.
To use the console, add console.log("Hello World!"); to your JavaScript file.

“When first starting on Thimble I had little to no experience/knowledge of JavaScript. It took me a while to get my bearings. As I started working on this project I had many hurdles to cross. But with the help of the core team I was able to slowly cross those hurdles. I still have lots to learn, but I'm happy with the progress so far!”

“I kare me cako i Thimble onongo pe atye ki ngec/knowledge me JavaScript. Ocwalla kare me nongo kacungu mamega. I kare ma acako tic i purujek man abedo ki peki mapol me akala. Ento ki kony pa tim ma ocwiny ni motmot abdedo ki kero me kato peko magi. Pud atye ki jami mapol me apwonya, ento cwinya yom ikom ngo ma dong otum!”
Working on some JavaScript? Thimble's built-in console makes it easier than ever to test and debug your code.
Itye katic ii JavaScript mo? Kacoc me Thimble ma kiyubo iyie weko bedo yot loyo me temo ko nongo bal i kod mamegi.
